name: NSE Market Terminal
description: Daily NSE workspace: live indices, breadth and India VIX, movers, a 30-symbol watchlist, portfolio P&L, price alerts, instrument research with benchmark comparison, and an index explorer, all from governed NSE reads with source receipts.
author: Vakyartha

nse-cmmkt__cm_get_live_indices.reason: Refresh the market overview’s exchange index levels.

nse-cmmkt__cm_get_stock_quote.reason: Read delayed quotes for tracked stocks, holdings and selected instruments.

nse__get_market_mood.reason: Refresh the exchange’s market breadth and descriptive statistics.

nse__get_bulk_quote.reason: Refresh last-close prices beyond the bounded live-quote set.

nse__get_stock_history.reason: Load a selected instrument’s historical prices for analysis.

nse__search_symbols.reason: Search for an exchange-listed company or symbol.

nse__get_52_week_high_low.reason: Read the selected instrument’s published 52-week range.

nse__get_stock_vs_index.reason: Compare a selected instrument with its benchmark.

nse__get_corporate_actions.reason: Read corporate actions for a selected instrument.

nse__get_volume_analysis.reason: Inspect trading volume for a selected instrument.

nse__get_top_by_volume.reason: Browse the most actively traded stocks.

nse__get_index_performance.reason: Inspect historical returns for a selected index.

nse__get_index_history.reason: Chart the selected index’s source price history.

nse__get_index_valuation.reason: Inspect the selected index’s published valuation history.

nse__get_index_snapshot.reason: Read the exchange index directory for index exploration.

app-news-desk__get_latest_articles.reason: Read saved related stories from News Desk during instrument research; this is a local cross-app read.

tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description: Latest delayed NSE indices, breadth and India VIX, top movers and tracked quotes, each with its time and basis

watchlist.description: Optional saved watchlist name; omitted uses the active list. Available names are returned in the result.

tools.name: get_market_brief
tools.description: A spoken-style market brief (indices, breadth, VIX, movers, sectors, watchlist, portfolio, alerts) written in sentences, and the same brief as a programme (segments with live charts and figures, and a price ticker) that another app can publish at its voice.listen path to play or watch

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: The user's NSE holdings valued from the latest saved quotes: value, day change and unrealised P&L in INR

tools.name: get_instrument
tools.description: Saved research for one NSE symbol: quote, daily analytics, 52-week range, benchmark beta and correlation, corporate actions, volume profile and related news

symbol.description: NSE symbol, such as TCS; defaults to the one open in Instrument

feeds.description: NSE equity quotes and indices snapshot

skills.name: nse-market-analyst
skills.description: Analyze Indian market indices, price movements, and market breadth from NSE Market Terminal
